1. **Choose what you want to make.** Select a **[Preset](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/controls.md#presets)** at the top of Controls. Its description tells you what media you need.
2. **Import your media.** Open **Assets** at the upper left. Drag files from your computer into the asset gallery, or click **Import** to choose them.
3. **Add media to your timeline.** [Drag files from Assets onto the rows](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline) named in your preset. The **Prepare your media** note below explains Driver, Guides and Audio.
4. **Create a prompt in your timeline.** Double-click empty **[Prompt](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#prompt-sections)** space near the bottom, describe what you want, then click **Create**. Scroll down inside the timeline if Prompt is out of view.
5. **Choose the part to generate.** Set **[In / Out](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** above the timeline; press **Enter** after each value. Start with a short range inside your footage when editing.
6. **Make your first version.** Open **[Render Queue](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-render-queue)** at the bottom of the Assets sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off. Click **Run** in ComfyUI, or **[Generate](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)** in Sonder App with **×1** selected.","group":"","order":9},"QP0FsWudkhPl":{"text":"**Review and export**

- **Watch your result.** With **Controls → Editor → Save as: Take**, each result appears as a new timeline clip. A [take](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#takes) is one generated version. Click **Play** below the preview. If the clip is muted, right-click it and choose **Unmute Selected**.
- **Choose the version to keep.** In **Assets**, double-click a result and open **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**. Back on the timeline, keep the winner visible on **Video** and mute competing takes. A favorite star marks an asset; it does not choose the version used in your video.
- **Check the soundtrack.** Keep only the sound you want playing. Linked picture and sound mute together; to mute just one, right-click its clip and choose **[Unlink Linked Items](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#linked-groups)** first.
- **Save your finished video.** Click **[Export](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#export-timeline)** above the timeline. Choose the full scene or selection, include the picture and sound you want, and use **High Quality MP4**. Open the saved file to check its picture, sound and length.","group":"","order":13},"F3rAfAEwQj-6":{"text":"**Make your video longer**

1. **Keep the part you like.** Leave your chosen video visible on a **Video** row. If an original Driver is still active, hide it using the eye at the left of its row.
2. **Set the total length.** Increase **Frames** at the right of the toolbar above the timeline. At **24 FPS**, **241 frames** is about **10 seconds** in total.
3. **Choose the sound for the new part.** Select **Make Video for Your Audio** to use existing sound, or **Make a New Video** to generate sound too. Existing Audio needs to cover the finished length.
4. **Choose only the part you are adding.** Set **[In](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** at the end of the kept video and **Out** at the new end. Press **Enter** after each value.
5. **Help the new part match.** Above the timeline, **[Ctx: Pre](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-generation-window)** includes earlier frames as a reference. Start with **49**, or fewer if your kept video is shorter. Keep **Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0**.
6. **Describe what happens next.** Double-click empty **Prompt** space at the start of the new part, type your description and click **Create**.
7. **Generate and check the join.** Generate the selected range, then play across the join to check the picture, motion and sound.

**Learn more:** [Extend a video](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#extend-a-video) · [Generate long-form video](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#generate-long-form-video)","group":"","order":14},"ltx_prepare_media":{"text":"**Prepare your media**

- **Choose the video you want to edit or follow.** The **[Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)** is your source video. Editing presets make a changed version of it. The three **Follow** presets use its layout, movement or outlines to guide a new video. Drag that video from Assets onto a **Video** row, then right-click its clip and choose **Convert to Driver**. It moves to **Driver** and disappears from normal preview; the original file stays in Assets.
- **Guide the result with a picture.** Drag a picture from Assets onto **[Guides](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#guide-frames)** at the frame it should guide. For **Edit With a Picture**, use a picture you have already edited and place it at **In**.
- **Add existing sound.** Drag a sound file from Assets onto **[Audio](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#audio-tracks)**. To add a video's picture and sound together, drop the video onto the [numbered ruler](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline) above the timeline rows. Dropping onto **Video** adds only the picture.
- **Keep the original sound while editing the picture.** Keep its Audio clip unmuted. In **Controls → Editor**, turn **Edit audio** and **Place take audio on timeline** off.","group":"","order":12},"ltx_requirements_setup":{"text":"**Requirements and setup**

**Install the required nodes.** Install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF) through [ComfyUI Manager](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/README.md#installation); search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes**, and **RES4LYF**, install all three, then restart ComfyUI and refresh your browser. RES4LYF supplies the **res_2s** method saved in **Generation Settings → Generation Method**. LTX, MoGe and SDPose nodes come with ComfyUI; update ComfyUI if they are missing. The **Models and downloads** note below lists the model files.

**Prepare the editor for LTX.** Above the timeline, use **[Model](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#model-templates): LTX 2.3 / 2.5** and **[Channels](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/prompts.md#channel-templates): Standard**. Channels changes the project's prompt fields.

**Try a short preview first.** Use **896 × 512**, **24 FPS**, and **In 0 / Out 121**. Set **Ctx: Pre/Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0** above the timeline for this first preview. Keep the range inside your footage when editing.

**Put results on the timeline.** In **Controls → Editor**, use **Save as: [Take](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#takes)**.","group":"","order":10},"ltx_models_downloads":{"text":"**Models and downloads**

1. **Choose what you want to make.** Select a **[Preset](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/controls.md#presets)** at the top of Controls. Its description tells you what media you need.
2. **Import your media.** Open **Assets** at the upper left. Drag files from your computer into the asset gallery, or click **Import** to choose them.
3. **Add media to your timeline.** [Drag files from Assets onto the rows](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline) named in your preset. The **Prepare your media** note below explains Driver, Guides and Audio.
4. **Create a prompt in your timeline.** Double-click empty **[Prompt](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#prompt-sections)** space near the bottom, describe what you want, then click **Create**. Scroll down inside the timeline if Prompt is out of view.
5. **Choose the part to generate.** Set **[In / Out](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** above the timeline; press **Enter** after each value. Start with a short range inside your footage when editing.
6. **Make your first version.** Open **[Render Queue](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-render-queue)** at the bottom of the Assets sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off. Click **Run** in ComfyUI, or **[Generate](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)** in Sonder App with **×1** selected.","group":"","order":9},"QP0FsWudkhPl":{"text":"**Review and export**

- **Watch your result.** With **Controls → Editor → Save as: Take**, each result appears as a new timeline clip. A [take](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#takes) is one generated version. Click **Play** below the preview. If the clip is muted, right-click it and choose **Unmute Selected**.
- **Choose the version to keep.** In **Assets**, double-click a result and open **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**. Back on the timeline, keep the winner visible on **Video** and mute competing takes. A favorite star marks an asset; it does not choose the version used in your video.
- **Check the soundtrack.** Keep only the sound you want playing. Linked picture and sound mute together; to mute just one, right-click its clip and choose **[Unlink Linked Items](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#linked-groups)** first.
- **Save your finished video.** Click **[Export](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#export-timeline)** above the timeline. Choose the full scene or selection, include the picture and sound you want, and use **High Quality MP4**. Open the saved file to check its picture, sound and length.","group":"","order":13},"F3rAfAEwQj-6":{"text":"**Make your video longer**

1. **Keep the part you like.** Leave your chosen video visible on a **Video** row. If an original Driver is still active, hide it using the eye at the left of its row.
2. **Set the total length.** Increase **Frames** at the right of the toolbar above the timeline. At **24 FPS**, **241 frames** is about **10 seconds** in total.
3. **Choose the sound for the new part.** Select **Make Video for Your Audio** to use existing sound, or **Make a New Video** to generate sound too. Existing Audio needs to cover the finished length.
4. **Choose only the part you are adding.** Set **[In](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** at the end of the kept video and **Out** at the new end. Press **Enter** after each value.
5. **Help the new part match.** Above the timeline, **[Ctx: Pre](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-generation-window)** includes earlier frames as a reference. Start with **49**, or fewer if your kept video is shorter. Keep **Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0**.
6. **Describe what happens next.** Double-click empty **Prompt** space at the start of the new part, type your description and click **Create**.
7. **Generate and check the join.** Generate the selected range, then play across the join to check the picture, motion and sound.

**Learn more:** [Extend a video](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#extend-a-video) · [Generate long-form video](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#generate-long-form-video)","group":"","order":14},"ltx_prepare_media":{"text":"**Prepare your media**

- **Choose the video you want to edit or follow.** The **[Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)** is your source video. Editing presets make a changed version of it. The three **Follow** presets use its layout, movement or outlines to guide a new video. Drag that video from Assets onto a **Video** row, then right-click its clip and choose **Convert to Driver**. It moves to **Driver** and disappears from normal preview; the original file stays in Assets.
- **Guide the result with a picture.** Drag a picture from Assets onto **[Guides](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#guide-frames)** at the frame it should guide. For **Edit With a Picture**, use a picture you have already edited and place it at **In**.
- **Add existing sound.** Drag a sound file from Assets onto **[Audio](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#audio-tracks)**. To add a video's picture and sound together, drop the video onto the [numbered ruler](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline) above the timeline rows. Dropping onto **Video** adds only the picture.
- **Keep the original sound while editing the picture.** Keep its Audio clip unmuted. In **Controls → Editor**, turn **Edit audio** and **Place take audio on timeline** off.","group":"","order":12},"ltx_requirements_setup":{"text":"**Requirements and setup**

**Install the required nodes.** Install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF) through [ComfyUI Manager](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/README.md#installation); search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes**, and **RES4LYF**, install all three, then restart ComfyUI and refresh your browser. RES4LYF supplies the **res_2s** method saved in **Generation Settings → Generation Method**. LTX, MoGe and SDPose nodes come with ComfyUI; update ComfyUI if they are missing. The **Models and downloads** note below lists the model files.

**Prepare the editor for LTX.** Above the timeline, use **[Model](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#model-templates): LTX 2.3 / 2.5** and **[Channels](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/prompts.md#channel-templates): Standard**. Channels changes the project's prompt fields.

**Try a short preview first.** Use **896 × 512**, **24 FPS**, and **In 0 / Out 121**. Set **Ctx: Pre/Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0** above the timeline for this first preview. Keep the range inside your footage when editing.

## LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX

Edit footage, create clean plates and masks, or generate new video and sound.

**Custom nodes:** [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF).

Install all three through the ComfyUI Manager by clicking on "Extensions" on the top right (search **Sonder Editor**, **KJNodes**, and **RES4LYF**), then restart ComfyUI and refresh this page.

1. On the **Sonder Editor** node below, choose a project or **+ Create New**, then click **Open Editor**.
2. Open **Controls** at the upper left and choose a **Preset**.
3. Expand **Start here** for the steps. **Requirements and setup** and **Models and downloads** are in the same panel.
